summary: Fourteen center allocations survive the new saturated-conductor and spectral-fibre constraints. A zero-residual Gram criterion forces additional nonnegative integral fusion products in every allocation. These partial products do not complete a center or categorification; general unbraided existence remains unresolved.

same_category_implications.explanation: The complete unrestricted signed-tensor argument leaves only sign gauges of the original tensor. The selected lifts form a spherical subcategory equivalent to the original category, proving that every categorification admits a spherical structure.

existence_implications.explanation: Every categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate with the same fusion ring. Thus general and pseudo-unitary categorifiability are equivalent as existence questions. This does not assert pseudo-unitarity of every original categorification or imply unitarity.

categorification_scope.record_scope_note: These statements report established results in the linked research record. Excluding a construction family, an associator choice or an induction frame does not exclude all categorifications with a given structure. The site’s independent-review caution applies to the recorded research proofs.

braided.explanation: The fusion ring is noncommutative: N[1,4,6]=1, whereas N[4,1,6]=2. A braiding would identify the two tensor products and force equal multiplicities. No pivotality assumption is needed.

morita.explanation: Every proper fusion subcategory is pointed and the global FP dimension is irrational. A braided Morita representative would therefore give a braiding on this category, by the tensor-image criterion. Hence no categorification of this ring is Morita equivalent to a braided fusion category.

tensor_convention: N[i][j][k] is the coefficient of X_k in X_i * X_j. Indices are zero-based; X_0 is the unit. The supplied source basis is preserved.
hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with separators=(',', ':') and no trailing newline. The formatted .txt file has the same tensor, not the same byte hash.
numeric_encoding_note: Exact integers outside the JavaScript safe-integer range (absolute value greater than 9007199254740991) are encoded as decimal strings to preserve every digit in browser display and JSON downloads. Fusion-tensor coefficients remain integers.

invariants.dimensions_method: Numerical Perron eigenvector, normalized at the tensor unit; approximate values.
invariants.character_method: Numerical regular-algebra block traces after exact rational center-kernel computation; χ_E(X_i) and f_E=(Σ_i χ_E(X_i)χ_E(X_i*)) / dim(E) are approximate. The displayed codegree minimal polynomials are exact factors of the rational central-Casimir polynomial rescaled by each irreducible degree; factor association uses the validated numerical eigenvalues. Orthogonality and block dimensions validated.
invariants.exact_dimension_method: Each FP dimension is the largest real root of its displayed irreducible polynomial, isolated by the rational interval. Factors and intervals are computed exactly from the integral fusion-matrix characteristic polynomial. The global dimension uses the central Casimir matrix.
invariants.fusion_matrix_convention: N_i[j][k] = N[i][j][k]; rows are the right input basis index, columns are the output basis index.
invariants.closed_based_subrings_method: Exhaustive subsets containing the unit, closed under duality and every nonzero fusion-product coefficient. Includes the unit subring and the whole ring.
